functions.name: execute
functions.doc: Anyone can execute a proposal that has passed. Upgrades use `execute_upgrade`.

functions.name: execute_upgrade
functions.doc:
Raw input: 8-byte little-endian proposal id, then the wasm. Needs two thirds of
 active members, and the wasm's sha256 must match the proposal.

functions.name: ft_on_transfer
functions.doc:
Deposit into your own pot with ft_transfer_call. Anything that isn't a deposit from an
 active member is handed straight back.

type_schema.description:
NEAR Account Identifier.

This is a unique, syntactically valid, human-readable account identifier on the NEAR network.

[See the crate-level docs for information about validation.](index.html#account-id-rules)

Also see [Error kind precedence](AccountId#error-kind-precedence).

## Examples

``` use near_account_id::AccountId;

let alice: AccountId = "alice.near".parse().unwrap();

assert!("ƒelicia.near".parse::<AccountId>().is_err()); // (ƒ is not f) ```

functions.name: get_held
functions.doc: The bookkeeping identity the token balance must match: pots plus unwithdrawn gifts.

functions.name: new
functions.doc:
Called once, by the circle account itself, in the same transaction as the deploy.
 After this the deployer deletes every access key, so nobody holds the circle.

functions.doc: Needs PROPOSAL_BOND attached. The circle keeps it to pay for storage.

functions.name: redraw
functions.doc: After the vouch window, anyone can replace drawn vouchers who didn't vouch.

functions.name: report_recovered
functions.doc: Back at work (or withdrawing an unconfirmed report). Gifts stop from this period.

functions.name: report_sick
functions.doc: Report that you're too sick to work. Draws two vouchers you don't choose.

functions.name: request_exit
functions.doc:
Start leaving. You still take part in the current period; your pot comes back once
 it's settled. A sick member who leaves keeps gifts through the current period.

functions.name: settle
functions.doc: Settles the next finished period. Anyone can call it, and each period settles once.

functions.name: veto
functions.doc: Any one member can veto an admission. That's the rule offline circles use too.

functions.name: vouch
functions.doc: A drawn voucher confirms they've seen the claimant and believe the report.

functions.name: withdraw
functions.doc:
Withdraw gifts you've received, plus your pot if your exit is final.
 Returns `true` straight away if your exit is final and there's nothing left to send.

gift_unit.description: Gift per period for level 1, in token units. Level n gets n times this.

max_gift_periods.description: Gift periods per report, at most 24.

period_secs.description: Length of one period. A month in production, a couple of minutes in the demo.

probation_periods.description: Periods a new member must wait before they can report sick.

proposal_secs.description: Admission proposals wait this long for vetoes; every proposal expires after twice this.

vouch_cooldown_periods.description: A member can't vouch for the same claimant again within this many periods.

vouch_window_secs.description: Time the two drawn vouchers have to vouch before anyone may redraw.

waiting_periods.description: Periods after a report before gifts start. The first month is the member's own risk.
